component.name: WordCraft
component.summary: Write and design documents; open and save Word files

description.p: This is a community package of WordCraft, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the WordCraft project. It repackages the official upstream Linux release build unmodified.
WordCraft is an open-source, native word processor written in Rust that follows the Microsoft Word workflow, with a familiar ribbon.

ul.li: Styles, tables, track changes, references and mail merge
Opens and saves .docx, ODT, RTF, HTML and Markdown, and exports PDF
Navigation pane and live style gallery
Every command can be driven by AI agents

description.p: The headless command runner and MCP server is included: flatpak run --command=wordcraft-cli ai.storyteller.wordcraft --help

Permissions: display (Wayland, with X11 as a fallback), the GPU device, and the Documents and Pictures folders. Files anywhere else are opened and saved through the system file chooser. No network access is granted.

ul.li: Let agents on the host reach the --control automation server: flatpak override --user --share=network ai.storyteller.wordcraft
Open files by path anywhere in your home folder (command line, Open Recent): flatpak override --user --filesystem=home ai.storyteller.wordcraft
